description: This file defines three command structures (StartCommand, StopCommand, RestartCommand) conforming to ParsableCommand for handling 'start', 'stop', and 'restart' commands within a command-line interface for the Swabble project. Each command includes a description and a run method that currently outputs placeholder messages indicating unimplemented functionality.
